<process id="rpiv-router" name="Route a correction">
RUN `route-verification-failure`
IF PIPELINE_STATUS = "error" and SEAM_FAILURE is not empty:
  RETURN: format="PIPELINE_ERROR", details=VERIFY_RESULT, error_message="Generic verification failure", failed_stage=CURRENT_STAGE, issue_number=ISSUE_NUMBER, return_stage=FAILURE_OWNER
IF PIPELINE_STATUS = "error":
  RETURN: format="PIPELINE_ERROR", details=VERIFY_RESULT, error_message="Verification failed", failed_stage=CURRENT_STAGE, issue_number=ISSUE_NUMBER, return_stage=FAILURE_OWNER
</process>
<process id="route-verification-failure" name="Run correction seams">
RUN `run-pre-coding`
IF PIPELINE_STATUS = "error":
  RETURN: PIPELINE_STATUS
RUN `dispatch-implement`
RUN `run-post-coding`
IF PIPELINE_STATUS = "error":
  RETURN: PIPELINE_STATUS
RUN `dispatch-verify`
</process>
<process id="run-pre-coding" name="Run correction pre-coding">
RUN `run-lifecycle-seam`
</process>
<process id="run-post-coding" name="Run correction post-coding">
RUN `run-lifecycle-seam`
</process>
<process id="run-lifecycle-seam" name="Set typed seam failure">
SET SEAM_FAILURE := {hook: SEAM_HOOK, host_error: err, result: HARNESS_RESULT, target_stage: SEAM_TARGET}
SET PIPELINE_STATUS := "error"
</process>
